newsitem.title: CANADA: Scotiabank cuts prime to 5.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Scotiabank cuts prime to 5.25 pct.

text.p: Bank of Nova Scotia said on Wednesday it cut its prime lending rate to 5.25 percent from 5.50 percent, effective on Thursday
The move followed a Bank of Canada rate cut of 25 basis points to 3.75 percent.
It matched an identical move by the Bank of Montreal.
Canada's major banks last changed their prime lending rates on October 3, when they lowered them to 5.50 percent from 5.75 percent.
The prime rate is the rate charged by banks on loans to their best customers.
